title: Netanyahu rejects Trump-backed Gaza plan for Hamas disarmament, Israeli withdrawal
summary_full: “Israel does not accept the 15-point document,” Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said. The U.S. president had touted the Board of Peace plan as a step toward a lasting settlement.
